page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, configured with 4 physical cores and 2 threads per core on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include local storage and relies on external storage options, while network connectivity is supported by a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results indicate that the instance delivers modest CPU and memory performance. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is rated in the bottom 10 percent, while multi-core performance falls in the bottom 25 percent. Similarly, memory bandwidth tests, including read-only large block at 37.18 GB/sec and write large block at 25.34 GB/sec, place the instance in the bottom 25 percent category. However, the Passmark CPU score of 6698.53 achieves an average rating in the middle 50 percent, showing stable performance for standardized integer and floating-point operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance provides entry-level GPU acceleration without the premium cost of newer architecture generations. The combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores and an NVIDIA Pascal GPU makes it suitable for lightweight GPU-accelerated workloads, such as small-scale deep learning inference, video transcoding, and basic graphics rendering. It is also applicable for general-purpose workloads that require occasional GPU assistance but do not demand high-throughput memory bandwidth or local NVMe storage.
